description: Exact math on sending money abroad or changing currency. Send the amount, the two currencies and each provider's fee and exchange rate (you find the quotes); divux returns what arrives with each, the exchange-rate markup against the ECB reference rate, the total cost as a percent, a ranking, and the World Bank average cost for the receiving country. With no quotes, it returns the reference rate and the benchmark. Rates are receiving currency per one unit of sending currency; a rate given the other way round is flipped and noted.

quotes.description: Quotes you found, one per provider

fee.description: Transfer fee in the sending currency (0 if none)

rate.description: Exchange rate offered: receiving currency per 1 sending currency

receive_amount.description: Amount the provider says arrives, if shown

receive_country.description: Receiving country's two-letter code, e.g. 'MX', for the World Bank benchmark

send_amount.description: Amount being converted, before fees, in the sending currency

name: compare_transfers
title: Money abroad: compare transfer quotes
